attchmntText: Kshitij Polyline Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kshitij Polyline Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at a meeting held on November 05, 2026. The publication appeared in Active Times and Mumbai Lakshdeep on November 07, 2026. HP Adhesives Limited also announced that its Board of Directors approved un-audited financial results for the same period on November 05, 2026. Film City Media Limited reported that its Board of Directors approved un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 05, 2026. Organic Coatings Limited stated that its Board of Directors approved un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 05, 2026. DCB Bank Limited issued an e-auction sale notice for immovable assets under the SARFAESI Act. The auction is scheduled for November 25, 2026. The reserve price is Rs. 76,00,000 for one property and Rs. 35,00,000 for another. A public notice was issued regarding a lost agreement for sale for Flat No. 403 in Mira Road. The Administrator General of Maharashtra issued a notice for Petition No. 14 of 2026 regarding the estate of Shri Devaji Suryakant Patil.
